title: An Explicit Formula for the Benjamin-Ono Hierarchy with Applications to Traveling Waves and Zero-Dispersion Limits
summary: In this paper, we first extend the explicit formula \cite{gerard2023explicit} for the classical Benjamin-Ono equation to each flow of the Benjamin-Ono hierarchy on line. We then use this representation to derive two main applications. First, we obtain a complete classification of traveling wave solutions for all higher-order flows in the hierarchy. Second, we analyze the zero-dispersion limit for the corresponding small-dispersion flows.
